blocks.text: Living in Queen Mary Park Surrey

parts.t: Queen Mary Park Surrey is an MLS® area in Surrey, named for Queen Mary Park. On the MLS® map it runs roughly from 120 Street east to King George Boulevard, and from 96 Avenue south to about 80 Avenue near 132 Street. The south edge is uneven, and all the edges are approximate. The City places the park north of 88 Avenue and west of 132 Street.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 13, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Surrey and Surrey Schools.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

blocks.text: Planning in Queen Mary Park Surrey

parts.t: Zoning and plan designations can be different for each lot.
The City approved its City Centre Plan in 2017 to guide growth in Surrey’s downtown. Ask the City whether a property is inside that plan area.
Queen Mary Park protects Healy Creek, so lots near the creek can have streamside limits.
On March 11, 2024, Council expanded the City Centre Plan boundary to take in the transit-oriented areas around SkyTrain stations, so check the current plan map for the address.

Near Healy Creek, check the land.

For a strata home, read the documents:
the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees, plus any special levies.
Ask whether it was built with a permit before you count on it.
Check the roof, drainage, furnace, plumbing and wiring.

Where is Queen Mary Park Surrey?

Queen Mary Park Surrey is an MLS® area name in Surrey. On the MLS® map it runs roughly from 120 Street on the west to King George Boulevard on the east, and from 96 Avenue on the north to about 80 Avenue near 132 Street on the south. The south edge is uneven. These edges are approximate and are not an official City boundary, so ask me if a specific address is in it.
